description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Recalling meeting in View of Selecting a new Chairman for the Vacated Chairman's Position of Katunayaka Seeduwa Urban Council on June 28 of 2021 at 09.30 a.m.
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a recalling meeting to select a new Chairman for the Katunayaka Seeduwa Urban Council, which falls under electoral processes for local government authorities. The notice is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, specifically dealing with the procedure for filling a vacated chairman position through an electoral process.
